g00-hello-were-kestrel: Hello, we're Kestrel. A Canada-wide eye care job board. Every job shows its pay. eyecarejobs.ca.
g01-how-people-fall-into-optics: Kestrel guide: How most people fall into optics. Few people plan a career in eye care. Most find it by chance, and many stay for good.
g02-job-ad-checklist: Kestrel guide: 4 things every job ad in Canada should include. 1, the pay range. 2, is it an existing vacancy? 3, do you use AI to screen applicants? 4, no "Canadian experience" requirement.
g03-cover-letter: Kestrel guide: Cover letters that get read. Why this clinic. What you would bring. When you could start. That is the whole letter.
g10-field-based-jobs: Kestrel guide: Eye care jobs on the road. Lens reps, clinical trainers, field technicians and account managers. What they do, and how to find the role.
g04-optometric-assistant-jobs: Kestrel guide: Optometric assistant jobs. The work and pay. What the job involves day to day, how pay varies across Canada, and how to start or move up.
g05-questions-before-you-say-yes: Kestrel guide: Questions to ask before you say yes. The patients, the lab, the hours, the pay, the training and the team.
g06-hire-for-attitude: Kestrel guide: Hire for attitude. Train for skills. Many good eye care staff start out in retail, hospitality or other health jobs.
g07-who-does-what: Kestrel guide: Who does what in an eye care clinic? More roles than most people expect, and many need no university degree.
g08-resume-tips: Kestrel guide: 4 tips for an eye care resume. 1, your registration status, if the job needs it. 2, 2 or 3 lines on who you are. 3, the tests, lenses and systems you know. 4, leave off your photo and date of birth.
g09-attract-the-right-people: Kestrel guide: How to attract the right people to your clinic. Show the pay. Describe the real week. Reply to everyone.
g11-optician-pay: Kestrel guide: Typical optician pay, by province. Highest, British Columbia at $30.82 an hour. 6 provinces between $28.00 and $30.10. Lowest, Ontario at $24.04 an hour.
g12-ai-chatbots: Kestrel blog: We asked the AI chatbots about eye care jobs. We were named in 0 of 21 answers. What they got right, and what they got wrong.
g13-pay-summary: Kestrel pay summary: 3 of 4 eye care roles pay most in British Columbia. Opticians, assistants and patient care teams. Our 2026 pay summary, from Job Bank figures.
